title: Electrons tracked through a pillbox's TM010: the energy they gain against qV₀T cos φ
source: A particle crossing a gap of length L at constant speed βc gains W = qV₀T cos φ, T = sin(x)/x, x = ωL/(2βc), φ its phase as it enters (T. P.
